name: Toa Quifer
source:
The Immaculate Adept

Prince of Qelsum. Forever composed and sparing with his expressions, he is a model student with a nigh perfect grasp of every situation. However, emotion free of reason resides beyond the walls he has built up inside, and only you can knock them down...

Indulgence: Sweets (particularly caramels.)
Pastime: Toying with his chess opponents and observing their reactions, reading

[From the English app "Court of Darkness"]
